theme: Open issue architecture triage and review packets

shots.title: Review gates accept CHANGES_REQUESTED evidence without resolved verdict
shots.notes: Added verdict metadata and rejection for changes_requested/blocked independent and PR review evidence.

shots.title: slope init --codex appends non-portable hooks and duplicate CODEBASE frontmatter
shots.notes: Project Codex hooks now use repo-relative commands; map metadata replacement consumes stacked leading YAML blocks.

shots.title: Add token-budgeted review packets and delta-only re-reviews
shots.notes: Added slope review packet with full/delta modes, budget tiers, excluded paths, packet hash, and gate evidence linkage.

shots.title: slope next ignores ready focused successor and merged latest scorecard
shots.notes: Next-sprint inference now prefers ready successors after latest scorecard/topology before historical backlog.

shots.title: post-merge retro leaves sprint status at ready_for_pr with stale next action
shots.notes: post-merge retro now reconciles matching local sprint state to complete.

shots.title: scorecard validation does not reconcile canonical modular roadmap status
shots.notes: Added modular roadmap complete command and validate-time source reconciliation guidance.

bunker_locations: Large open-issue batches can hide feature-sized work among fix tickets; triage feature scope before implementation.
yardage_book_updates: Review gate evidence should carry verdict metadata and packets should be bounded before reviewers run.
For modular roadmaps, use slope roadmap complete --sprint=N rather than editing generated roadmap.json.
course_management_notes: Implemented #609 as a minimal compatible packet generator instead of a full reviewer orchestration system.
